title: Mount Shasta portal opening and the 10-foot being

tellings.quote: in 2014 they opened one 2015 I interviewed almost everybody that was in the portal. What did you see? He was this 10- foot tall guy and he had boots on.

plain: In 2014, a portal is said to have opened at Mount Shasta, a mountain in northern California, and someone who was there describes seeing a ten-foot-tall man wearing boots. This comes from the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, who says that in 2015 he interviewed almost everyone who had been at the portal and asked them what they saw. He names no single witness, and if the account were true it would mean people met a giant being face to face.
